en: A black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) view of a slightly sloping street lined with two‑ and three‑story townhouses on both sides. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and traditional German architectural elements. Utility poles and early telegraph/telephone lines run along the street. Small groups of people are walking or standing on the sidewalks. At the top of the image, printed in red Gothic-style script, it reads "Zöblitz i. Erzgeb." on the left and "Johannes-Strasse" on the right.
